protocol_characterization: Beanstalk 'The Finale' is a credit-based, oracle-free stablecoin (BEAN ~= $1) implemented as an EIP-2535 Diamond. Value/peg flows: Sun (sunrise/gm advances seasons; stepOracle->deltaB->LibWellMinting mints BEAN to Silo/Field/Barn via Multi-Flow Pump TWAP over Wells/Basin), Silo (deposits -> BDV -> stalk + roots = governance weight + earned-BEAN share), Field (sow BEAN -> pods/debt, harvested in season order), Barn (Fertilizer/unripe pays down debt). Tractor/Pipeline/Farm/Depot provide permissionless arbitrary/batched call execution into the diamond. This snapshot is the L1->L2 (Arbitrum) migration + reseed: L1 burns/locks, L2 Reseed*.init() and L2ContractMigrationFacet bulk-write all subsystem state.
trust_model: Diamond owner controls diamondCut and the one-shot Reseed*.init()/InitReseed delegatecalls that seed all L2 state; reseed input data is trusted (off-chain computed from L1). Whitelisted tokens, oracle implementations, and well/pump addresses are admin-configured. Users are untrusted and interact permissionlessly with Silo/Field/Barn/Sun/Convert/Tractor/Pipeline. Cross-chain trust: an Arbitrum bridge contract (msg.sender==BRIDGE, xDomainMessageSender==L1BEANSTALK) gates L1-origin Bean remint.

protocol_invariants_spanning_subsystems: Stalk conservation: s.sys.silo.stalk (global) MUST equal the sum of all s.accts[].stalk; roots conservation likewise. Enforced as a safety net by Invariable.noNetFlow/noOutFlow which read s.sys.silo.stalk as baseline.

Per-token solvency (Invariable.fundsSafu): contract token balance >= entitlements = silo.balances[token].deposited + germinating + internal balances + (for BEAN) unrinsed fertilized + unripe underlying + unharvested harvestable.
Silo global total == sum of accounts: s.sys.silo.balances[token].deposited/.depositedBdv MUST equal sum of per-account deposits.
Migration completeness/conservation: total L1 stalk/roots/deposits/pods/fertilizer/internal balances reseeded on L2 == their L1 values, exactly once, with no inflation or loss.
Peg integrity: BEAN issuance (sunrise mint) and convert valuation MUST be driven by manipulation-resistant pump TWAP, not single-block spot.
external_dependencies_note: No third-party deps surfaced by static crossref; integrations are in-repo libs (LibWellMinting, LibChainlinkOracle, LibUsdOracle) wrapping external Wells/Chainlink/bridge contracts.

agent_hints.logic: Reseed sequence completeness is the protocol-level theme: confirm every global aggregate (silo.stalk, silo.roots, silo.balances[token], field.pods, fert chain) is reconciled to the sum of reseeded per-account values across the FULL init set, not per file.
agent_hints.oracle: Confirm sunrise mint + convert valuation read pump cumulative TWAP, and whether the inverted LibChainlinkOracle ternary (DT-006) reaches a financial consumer feeding peg/mint.
agent_hints.economic_attack: Roots desync after reseed lets the first post-migration mower capture a disproportionate roots/earned-BEAN share vs the reseeded population.
agent_hints.snapshot: Global stalk = governance quorum baseline; a zero/understated global total mis-scales every vote and the Invariable stalk-decrease guard.
agent_hints.access_control: Reseed*.init() are external with no access modifier (ACCESS-001) — confirm one-shot diamondCut wiring so they are not re-callable post-upgrade.

findings.title: L1->L2 reseed never initializes global Silo total stalk/roots (s.sys.silo.stalk / s.sys.silo.roots), breaking the protocol-wide stalk-conservation invariant and corrupting roots/earned-Bean accounting for the entire migrated population
findings.description: Stalk and roots are governance weight and earned-Bean share. The protocol-wide invariant is that the global totals s.sys.silo.stalk and s.sys.silo.roots equal the sum of all per-account s.accts[].stalk / .roots; Invariable.noNetFlow/noOutFlow even enforce 'global stalk does not decrease' against s.sys.silo.stalk as a safety net. During the L1->L2 reseed, ReseedSilo.reseedSiloDeposit issues per-account stalk (s.accts[account].stalk = accountStalk) and per-token global balances, but NEVER writes the global aggregates s.sys.silo.stalk or s.sys.silo.roots. Tracing the entire beanstalk/init/ tree (InitReseed.init, ReseedSilo, ReseedSun, ReseedWhitelist, ReseedField, ReseedBarn, ReseedInternalBalances) confirms there is no write to s.sys.silo.stalk or s.sys.silo.roots anywhere in the reseed/init sequence (grep over beanstalk/init/ returns only the per-account s.accts[].stalk assignment). DT-009 raised this symptom as Medium 'pending a trace of where total stalk is set'; that trace is now complete and the global totals are confirmed to remain zero after migration. Consequences span subsystems: (1) Roots minting breaks — LibSilo.mintActiveStalk and LibGerminate take the `s.sys.silo.roots == 0` branch and mint roots = stalk * ROOTS_BASE as if the first post-migration actor were the genesis depositor, while every reseeded account holds stalk but ZERO roots; since roots (not stalk) determine earned-Bean distribution, the entire migrated population earns near-zero yield and the first mower/depositor captures a grossly disproportionate root share. (2) Global stalk is understated to 0 while Sigma(accts.stalk) is large, violating stalk conservation; LibGauge (s.sys.silo.stalk.div(totalBdv)) computes wrong gauge output, and the Invariable noNetFlow/noOutFlow baseline is wrong from genesis. (3) LibReceiving sunrise earned-Bean shipping increments global stalk by minted Beans only, so the desync between account stalk and global stalk/roots is permanent. This is a protocol-level, cross-subsystem (Silo + Sun + migration-completeness) invariant break not owned by any single specialist's per-account finding.

related: beanstalk/init/InitReseed.sol (init: sets paused/season/flags, no global stalk/roots)

findings.impact: Permanent post-migration corruption of the global Silo stalk/roots accounting for the whole protocol: reseeded depositors hold stalk with zero roots and therefore earn near-zero share of all future earned-Bean (sunrise) distributions, while the first post-migration actor mints genesis-scale roots and captures a disproportionate yield/voting share; governance quorum (vote weight aggregate) and LibGauge output are mis-scaled; the Invariable stalk-conservation safety net operates against a wrong baseline. Affects every migrated holder with no attacker required (self-triggers on the reseed), with an additional opportunistic economic upside for the first mower.
findings.proof_of_concept: Static/trace-level (no fork run in-session): (1) grep -rn 'sys.silo.stalk|sys.silo.roots' over beanstalk/init/ returns no assignment (only s.accts[].stalk in ReseedSilo:164). (2) ReseedSilo.reseedSiloDeposit writes per-account stalk and per-token silo.balances but no global total. (3) Post-reseed state therefore has s.sys.silo.stalk == 0 and s.sys.silo.roots == 0 while Sigma(s.accts[].stalk) > 0. (4) First post-migration silo interaction calling mow -> mintActiveStalk hits the roots==0 branch (LibSilo:184) minting stalk*ROOTS_BASE roots to that single actor; all reseeded accounts retain 0 roots. (5) Earned-Bean distribution (germination/LibReceiving) allocates by roots, so reseeded population earns ~0 while the genesis-root actor earns the bulk. Foundry PoC to confirm: fork/deploy reseed fixture, assert vm.load(silo.stalk slot)==0 and silo.roots slot==0 after init while an account stalk slot is non-zero (L2 state-flip), then call mow as a fresh EOA and assert that account receives ROOTS_BASE-scaled roots and a reseeded account's earned-Bean share is ~0 (L3 outcome).

ite.intent: After the L1->L2 reseed the global Silo total stalk and roots must equal the sum of all reseeded per-account stalk/roots, so earned-Bean distribution, governance weight, gauge math, and the Invariable safety net all operate on a consistent base.
ite.technique: The reseed writes only per-account stalk (and per-token deposited balances) and omits initializing the global aggregates s.sys.silo.stalk and s.sys.silo.roots; downstream roots minting branches on roots==0 and divides by silo.stalk.
ite.evasion: No attacker is needed to trigger the corruption (it self-triggers on the migration upgrade); an opportunistic first-mover can additionally capture genesis-scale roots before others mow.

ice_chain.consumer_function: LibSilo.mintActiveStalk / LibGerminate (roots minting), earned-Bean distribution by roots, LibGauge, Invariable.noNetFlow/noOutFlow
ice_chain.impact: Reseeded population earns ~0 earned-Bean and holds 0 roots; first post-migration actor mints disproportionate genesis-scale roots; gauge/governance/safety-net all mis-scaled
